player_prompt.intro:
Iwe Mufambi {player_id} muGerman Whist.
{phase_info}
Ina {hand_size} makadi.
Cheza kadi na '[play N]', apo N ni nhande yake munhande (kwa mfano '[play 3]').
player_prompt.phase_learning: LEARNING PHASE: the winner of each trick takes the face-up card and the loser draws the next card from the deck. Tricks won in this phase do not count towards victory.
player_prompt.phase_playing: PLAYING PHASE: the deck is exhausted. Every trick from now on counts towards victory.

next_card.playing_phase: Hapana kadhi riri kupiwa - nhambo yokutamba yatanga.
next_card.deck_empty: Dheketi harina chinhu - hapana kadhi riri kupiwa.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Invalid move format. Shandisa '[play N]' kutamba Nth kadhi riri muruoko rwako.
invalid_move.bad_position: Nzvimbo iyoyo yekadhi haipo. Une makadhi {hand_size}.
invalid_move.must_follow_suit: Unofanira kutevera muenzaniso uye kutamba kadhi {lead_suit}.

trick.won_learning: Mufambi {winner_id} anotonga cherecheso na {card} na kuchukua kadi yakatizira.

phase.learning_complete: The deck is exhausted. The learning phase is over - every remaining trick counts towards victory.

turn.scores_learning: Macherecheso anotonga kusvika sasa - Mufambi 0: {tricks0}, Mufambi 1: {tricks1}

board_str.player_line:
{observation}
Mufambi {player_id}: {scoring} kucherechesa makadi ({tricks} wose), {hand_size} makadi munhande

outcome.summary: Learning phase - Player 0: {l0}, Player 1: {l1}. Playing phase - Player 0: {p0}, Player 1: {p1}. Player {winner_id} wins with {winner_tricks} scoring tricks!
